scope_text: Bounded synthetic profile only. The comparator applications (the OPA application and the LangGraph plus OPA application) are configured by Cognous, not vendor implementations. This is not independent certification and not production readiness; operational trust stays on HOLD. Linux only.
status: Declared interface of the LangGraph plus OPA application of the Wiki comparator. The graph layer adds no policy logic; the base application's declaration (declared-interface-opa-app.json) applies to every request it passes on. Source references are verified by comparators/tests/test_interface_declarations.py.
request_fields_read: none by this layer; the graph reads only request.body.id (thread id) and passes the signed request unchanged to the base OPA application
operations: execute (via approval node, then effect node or deny node)
event_shape_for_graph_denials: events(body) JSON, same keys and order as the Wiki OPA application's denied-execute rows: operation, command, request_digest (full signed request), status, reason, at, command_authenticated, threshold_alert (False), hold (True only for APPROVAL_PENDING), policy_skipped (False), reasons ([reason]); written by WikiOpaApp.record_denial
known_absences: no policy logic in the graph layer
no user, tool or window concept of its own
approval is an explicit step method, no real time or human
base_application: comparators/wiki/apps/wiki_opa_app.py WikiOpaApp (real subclass relation; graph class WikiLangGraphOPA built by make_wiki_langgraph_app)
mutation_grammar: graph_<name> optionally combined with base families: graph_x+family+family; at most one graph_ part; unknown names raise
world_extensions: none of its own; the world extensions of declared-interface-opa-app.json (world_extensions) are inherited with the base application and reach every request the graph passes on
